subject: Vendor activation: purchase orchestration and line-item normalization
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@skyforge.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding — PO details and spend-cap mismatch

Hi Jonas / Laura —

Thanks for the walkthrough last week. We're ready to proceed with Redwood's onboarding checklist and have attached our completed onboarding form (SkyForge_Onboarding_Form.pdf) and the draft PO you shared (PO_Draft_2432.xlsx). A couple of items need alignment before we can sign: 

- The draft PO shows a total annual spend cap of $100,000 but the itemized monthly SKUs sum to a projected $12,500/mo (~$150,000/yr). Can you confirm which figure is the authoritative cap?
- Line item #2 in the spreadsheet ("GPU-hours credit") appears twice with different unit codes — one line uses SKU GF-GPU-HR and the other GF-GPU-HR-BK. We expect just one line for reserved GPU credits and a separate line for burst credits.
- We need a provisional PO number to start onboarding (tax/legal require a PO on file before provisioning).

We can provide the signed onboarding form once the PO numbers and spend cap are reconciled. I also included a link to our SOW for the initial quarter: https://docs.skyforge.io/SOW-SkyForge-Redwood-2026.pdf

Appreciate any quick guidance — we need to get this in front of our finance team by end of week.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of GTM Operations | SkyForge, Inc.
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: SkyForge_Onboarding_Form.pdf (form), PO_Draft_2432.xlsx (draft PO spreadsheet)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@skyforge.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — PO details and spend-cap mismatch

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the clear note and the attachments. Quick answers and next steps: 

1) Authoritative cap: procurement sets the formal spend cap in the PO header; the line-item totals must reconcile to that number. If your expected committed amount is $150k/yr we should reflect that in the header OR split the commitment into a $100k committed tranche plus an optional burst pool.

2) Line items: agree the duplicate GPU line looks like a mapping artifact from your export. Ben (cc) — can you confirm the canonical sku mapping and collapse to two lines: Reserved GPU credits (monthly recurring) + Burst GPU credits (consumable)? Also add a separate line for egress/backups if present.

3) Provisional PO number: Ben / Procurement typically issues a provisional P- number for onboarding within 24–48 hours if the vendor has submitted tax ID and signed onboarding form. Elena — if you can confirm the vendor Tax ID and attach the SOW we can start the provisional issuance.

Proposed timeline: Ben creates provisional PO by Thu (23 Jul) assuming Tax ID & resolved line item mapping; final PO issued after Marissa approves any spend-cap exceptions.

I'll hold off on final approval until we see the corrected PO.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — PO details and spend-cap mismatch

Jonas / Laura —

On it. Elena — can you confirm the following so Procurement can spin up a provisional PO? 

- Legal business name exactly as it should appear on the PO
- Tax ID / VAT number
- Point of contact for invoicing (name, email)
- Confirmation whether SkyForge wants a single annual cap or a split: committed cap = $100,000 + optional burst pool = $50,000 (monthly billing for reserved credits + on-demand bursts)

If we need to exceed the standard per-vendor spend cap (our default single-vendor cap is $100k without an executive exception), I'll route a spend-cap exception to Marissa for approval. Otherwise I can issue a provisional PO number (P-2026-xxxx) and mark the header with committed vs burst buckets.

Ben Carter
Vendor Enablement Manager | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

Attachments: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — PO details and spend-cap mismatch

Ben / team —

Approved conditionally: I will sign off on a spend-cap up to $125,000 for SkyForge for the first 12 months provided we: 
- Add a monthly reconciliation clause in the PO header (close monitoring for first 3 months)
- Split billing into a committed $100k tranche and a burst pool not to exceed $25k unless pre-approved
- Hold back 10% retainage on the first invoice until initial integration checks are complete (shared checklist to vendor)

Ben: please draft the provisional PO with those fields and include an explicit line for "Integration holdback (10% — refundable)". If the vendor insists on $150k firm, escalate back to me with a short business justification from Jonas.

Marissa Cole
VP, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Elena Morales <elena@skyforge.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 09:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — PO details and spend-cap mismatch

Thanks, Marissa / Ben —

Confirmed details below so you can proceed: 
- Legal name: SkyForge, Inc.
- US Tax ID (EIN): 27-3498123
- Invoicing POC: Kamal Raj <kamal.raj@skyforge.io>
- We accept the split structure: committed $100,000 + burst pool $25,000 (we will mark anything beyond that as pre-approved expansion request)

I also uploaded the signed onboarding form to your shared link and the SOW is at https://docs.skyforge.io/SOW-SkyForge-Redwood-2026.pdf. Please let us know the provisional PO number and any additional items needed to complete the provisioning.

Best,
Elena

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@skyforge.io>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 16:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — PO details and spend-cap mismatch

Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround. Provisional PO has been created: P-2026-7894. Summary of header fields: 
- Vendor: SkyForge, Inc. (EIN 27-3498123)
- Committed annual cap: $100,000 (monthly charge mapped to SKU GF-RES-GPU)
- Burst pool: $25,000 (consumable SKU GF-BURST-GPU)
- Integration holdback: 10% of first invoice (line item: Integration holdback - refundable)
- PO stub attached: PO_P-2026-7894.pdf

Action items: 
- Elena / SkyForge: finalize the sign-off on the onboarding form you uploaded and confirm Kamal Raj as invoicing POC (we've copied Kamal on the metadata entry).
- Jonas: you can proceed with provisioning using the provisional PO; final PO will replace provisional once legal completes the SOW sign-off.

I'll update the HubSpot procurement record: HO-48213 and attach the finalized PO. If any line-item codes still look off (that GF-GPU-HR vs GF-GPU-HR-BK issue), I will normalize to GF-RES-GPU and GF-BURST-GPU and notify you.

Thanks all,
Ben Carter
Vendor Enablement Manager | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

Attachments: PO_P-2026-7894.pdf
